headlines.title: Harbinger raises $240M after expanding into defense
headlines.summary: The Los Angeles-based startup has now raised more than $650 million, and is working on electric trucks, emergency vehicles, and a driverless platform for the military.

headlines.title: Harbinger raises $240M to expand EV platform beyond trucks
headlines.summary: The Garden Grove, California, company has raised more than $650 million since 2021. FedEx and THOR Industries participated as strategic investors in the new round The post Harbinger raises $240M to expand EV platform beyond trucks appeared first on FreightWaves.

headlines.title: Harbinger Raises $240 Million Series D Funding Round, Led by Tiger Global
headlines.summary: Harbinger, an American industrial technology platform company, today announced that they have raised $240 million in Series D funding to help fuel the company's next phase of growth. The funding round was co-led by Tiger Global, Capricorn's Technology Impact Fund and Ridgeline.

headlines.title: US Army enlists FedEx to modernize logistics at depots
headlines.summary: FedEx is partnering with the U.S. Army to optimize logistics and delivery for the service’s depots, arsenals and ammunition plants. The post US Army enlists FedEx to modernize logistics at depots appeared first on FreightWaves.

headlines.title: FedEx uses dedicated logistics teams to win aerospace, automotive business
headlines.summary: FedEx says its new strategy to provide premium logistics services for industrial companies has resulted in new contracts to move aircraft engines and auto parts. The post FedEx uses dedicated logistics teams to win aerospace, automotive business appeared first on FreightWaves.

description: FedEx Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides transportation, e-commerce, and business services in the United States and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Express U.S. Domestic and Express International. It provides e-commerce and digital solutions; dataworks; printing and shipping management, including digital printing, professional finishing, document creation, design solutions, direct mail, signs and graphics, custom-branded boxes, copying, computer rental, Wi-Fi, corporate print solutions, shredding, U.S. passport processing and renewal, and digital notarization; packing services, as well as packing supplies and boxes; document and business services; and retail access for package transportation. In addition, the company offers logistics services, air and ocean cargo transportation, specialty transportation, customs brokerage, trade management tools and data, and door-to-door solutions; and third party logistics and supply chain management solutions, such as inbound logistics, warehousing and distribution, fulfillment, contract packaging and product configuration, systems integration, returns process and disposition, test, repair, refurbishment, and product liquidation. Further, it provides sales, marketing, administrative, information technology, and back-office support services. FedEx Corporation was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee.
